analysis.overview: The frames overlap only on how quieter surroundings support sustained reading. The reference otherwise covers broad personal routines, preferences, safeguards, and planning constraints, while the compared frame adds reading-workspace organization, notification management, page tracking, and a prediction limit without contradiction.
